limitations: Only quadrilaterals with sides parallel to chords of an affine-regular heptagon are treated.
The unrestricted minimum enclosing quadrilateral area is not determined.
No general Kuperberg or chord-conjecture result is claimed.
Historical priority outside the inspected literature is provisional.
scientific_integrity: The exact ratio and seven optimizer classes follow from an analytical finite reduction and a 511-case exact rational-interval certificate supplied in heptagon_cert.py; this is not an independent external mathematical audit. The motivating paper reported the approximate value 1.2588 and a general finite-candidate framework.
title: Sharp chord-quadrilateral enclosure of the regular heptagon
